recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-47845. If the checked-in DetectedIssue SVG is still consumed by the publication process, refresh that generated diagram through the normal generation/build path rather than hand-editing it as an issue reconciliation source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-47845 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 after the reporter noted that DetectedIssue.category and DetectedIssue.code should not both use the Detected Issue Category value set. The accepted resolution was to bind category to a category-only value set and code to the full detected-issue code value set, matching FHIR-39458.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-47845. The Jira comment says it was applied in FHIR-39458, and git commit 34181b9f2184a72b527d9f5b26c234c0c07669ed created valueset-detectedissue-code.xml, restricted valueset-detectedissue-category.xml to category concepts, and rebound DetectedIssue.code from ValueSet/detectedissue-category to ValueSet/detectedissue-code.
additional_context: DetectedIssue is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml and the DetectedIssue value sets are in build scope. FHIR-44531 is another Applied tracker with the same concern and resolution. The 2025-03-05 CDS agenda records approval of the proposed and pre-applied FHIR-47845 resolution. source/detectedissue/detectedissue.svg still shows the old DetectedIssue.code binding, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source binds DetectedIssue.category to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/detectedissue-category and DetectedIssue.code to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/detectedissue-code; the category value set lists high-level category concepts while the code value set uses the broader v3 ActCode detected-issue hierarchy filters.

related_jiras.note: Implemented the accepted DetectedIssue category/code value-set split that FHIR-47845 says to reuse.
